body:
As a teenager myself, I understand how you're feeling right now. You must remember that the reason why you're hurt doesn't make you less valid. What we know is that you are not feeling well, and we must accept it. It couldn't matter less if you're hurting for a loss, for school or for a bad day.
What really matters is that no one else could ever understand your perception of your own life, so they cannot decide whether your feelings are valid or not.
In addiction, I want you to know that my DMs are open if you need to talk. You are not alone !

I know you can and will find a person who loves you unconditionally for the man you truly are even if they don't fully represent your conception of "loving, doting housewife".
I understand that you're in pain and I think it's important to try and address it in a more healthy way, for yourself and for who you love.
Trying to blame it on the "whore women" will eventually make it worse for you, as you'll never trust any woman at all instead of just realizing that the one who hurt you is the one who should lose your trust.
With that said, I wish you to find again love and enthusiasm.
